android.desc:
Redz: Watch Series. Create, Participate, Get Paid!

Redz is where short videos and images become series. Post parts, build a following, and turn views into income, all from your phone.

Series, not just videos
Every creator on Redz builds their own Series: connected episodes, in video or images, that people follow, binge, and come back for. It's a new way to tell stories and keep your audience hooked, one Part at a time.

Discover what's trending near you
See the hottest Series and most-watched content around you. Explore what people are watching, talking about, and sharing.

Features:
-Create and grow your own Series with videos and images, episode by episode
-Earn commission through Redz by creating Series or participating in other users' series
-Explore trending Series by location, worldwide or right around you
-Follow your favorite creators and never miss a new Part
-Discover what's happening now with the Series feed

Redz. Post more. Earn more.
